title: Two-gram
statementMd:
Two-gram is an ordered pair (i.e. string of length two) of capital Latin letters. For example, "`AZ`", "`AA`", "`ZA`" — three distinct two-grams.

You are given a string $s$ consisting of $n$ capital Latin letters. Your task is to find **any** two-gram contained in the given string **as a substring** (i.e. two consecutive characters of the string) maximal number of times. For example, for string $s$ = "`BBAABBBA`" the answer is two-gram "`BB`", which contained in $s$ three times. In other words, find any most frequent two-gram.

Note that occurrences of the two-gram can overlap with each other.

## Input

The first line of the input contains integer number $n$ ($2 \le n \le 100$) — the length of string $s$. The second line of the input contains the string $s$ consisting of $n$ capital Latin letters.

## Output

Print the only line containing exactly two capital Latin letters — **any** two-gram contained in the given string $s$ **as a substring** (i.e. two consecutive characters of the string) maximal number of times.

## Note

In the first example "`BA`" is also valid answer.

In the second example the only two-gram "`ZZ`" can be printed because it contained in the string "`ZZZAA`" two times.
statementZhMd:
二元组是由大写拉丁字母组成的有序对（即长度为 2 的字符串）。例如，`AZ`、`AA`、`ZA` 是三个不同的二元组。

给定一个由 $n$ 个大写拉丁字母组成的字符串 $s$。你的任务是找出在给定字符串中作为**子串**（即字符串中两个连续的字符）出现次数最多的**任意一个**二元组。例如，对于字符串 $s$ = `BBAABBBA`，答案是二元组 `BB`，它在 $s$ 中出现了三次。换句话说，请找出出现频率最高的任意一个二元组。

注意，二元组的不同出现可以彼此重叠。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$2 \le n \le 100$），表示字符串 $s$ 的长度。输入的第二行包含由 $n$ 个大写拉丁字母组成的字符串 $s$。

## 输出格式

输出一行，包含恰好两个大写拉丁字母，即在给定字符串 $s$ 中作为**子串**（即字符串中两个连续的字符）出现次数最多的**任意一个**二元组。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，`BA` 也是一个有效答案。

在第二个样例中，可以输出唯一的二元组 `ZZ`，因为它在字符串 `ZZZAA` 中出现了两次。
